item.title: Justice Will Sellers: George Washington's integrated army
item.description: In 1776 – 250 years ago – General George Washington made a pragmatic and radical decision when he integrated the Continental Army, allowing free black men – and later some formerly enslaved men – to serve alongside white soldiers. Rather than being driven by enlightened ideas or progressive principles, Washington’s command decision reflected practical military necessity, political calculation, and an evolving understanding of liberty. item.title: Illegal alien sentenced for trafficking heroin in Bessemer
item.description: An illegal alien was sentenced on heroin-trafficking charges last week.U.S. District Judge Annemarie Axon sentenced Jovani Correa-Gutierrez, 40, to 46 months in federal prison. Correa-Gutierrez pleaded guilty in May to conspiracy to distribute heroin and possession with intent to distribute heroin.According to the plea agreement, Correa-Gutierrez and a co-conspirator worked to distribute almost 2 kilograms of heroin to a confidential source. item.title: Auburn begins two-game road swing at Ole Miss
item.description: Still searching for its first true road win of the season, Auburn heads to Oxford on Tuesday night to face Ole Miss at the Sandy and John Black Pavilion.
